description: The pricing for Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced has leaked ahead of the game's official reveal. According to a tipster, the Launch Edition of the Black Flag remake will be priced $59.99 in the US (EUR 59,99€ / GBP 49.99). The Collector’s Edition, on the other hand, will cost $199.99 (EUR 199,99 / GBP174.99).
title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced Pricing Leaked Ahead of Official Reveal

description: With every manufacturer already having a bunch of AI tools for composing text on the fly, Nothing has decided on introducing its own AI tool built specifically for its smartphones and to work within its ecosystem of apps.
title: Essential Voice: A Useful AI Addition to Nothing’s Intelligence Toolkit?

description: WhatsApp has integrated mobile recharges into the popular messaging app. The platform has collaborated with Dutch payments company PayU to enable the service in the country across WhatsApp for Android and iOS. With the latest update, Airtel, Jio, and Vodafone Idea users can choose from a range of recharge plans and carry out recharges within a few taps without leaving WhatsApp. This facility is rolling out in phases and will be available to all users over the coming weeks.
title: WhatsApp Launches Prepaid Mobile Recharges for Users in India: How to Recharge Your Mobile Number

description: Samsung has published a paper in Nature, the science journal, on the switchable 2D/3D display technology, which uses a metasurface lenticular lens-based solution. The South Korea-based tech conglomerate said that the metasurface lenticular lens-based solution will enable the company to bring 3D displays to future smartphones, tablets, and commercial systems to make virtual 2D images appear to be popping out of their screens. The technology would also allow users to toggle between 2D and 3D modes. A report suggests that the tech giant is expected to bring the functionality with its rumoured Samsung Galaxy S28 Ultra.
title: Samsung Details Switchable 2D/3D Display Technology That Could Come to Future Galaxy Phones

description: Honor has launched the Honor Win H9 and Win H7 gaming laptops in China with Intel Core HX processors and Nvidia RTX 50-series GPUs. The lineup includes high refresh rate 16-inch displays, up to RTX 5070 Ti graphics, and large batteries with fast charging. Prices start at CNY 11,999 (roughly Rs. 1,64,900) for the Win H9 and CNY 9,199 (roughly Rs. 1,26,600) for the Win H7. Both models offer DDR5 RAM, SSD storage, AI features, and modern connectivity, with availability across Honor stores and online platforms.
title: Honor Win H7, Win H9 Launched With Up to Intel Core 9 Ultra HX CPU: Price, Specifications

description: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra design has been spotted in leaked promotional material and renders again. The images, along with a marketing video, were shared online by a tipster. The images show the handset in purple and brown colour options, featuring textured and wooden finishes, respectively. Moreover, the outer display appears to feature relatively thin bezels, along with two cameras in the top-left corner, placed next to an LED flash. The phone is expected to be launched later this year with gesture control for the camera.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Design, Colour Options Spotted in Leaked Renders and Promotional Image

description: The UK’s FCA has raided multiple locations linked to illegal P2P crypto trading operations. Authorities issued cease-and-desist notices and launched investigations with support from law enforcement agencies. The move reflects a broader crackdown on unregistered crypto activity amid rising financial crime concerns.
title: UK’s FCA Raids Multiple Sites Suspected of Illegal P2P Crypto Operations

description: Honor Earbuds 4 have rolled out to select global markets after debuting in China in October 2025. The TWS earbuds feature dual drivers, up to 50dB hybrid ANC, and spatial-style audio. They use Bluetooth 5.3, support AI translation, and offer low-latency mode. Battery life is rated at up to nine hours, or 46 hours with the case. Prices start at AED 169 (roughly Rs. 4,300), SAR 199 (roughly Rs. 4,500), and MYR 399 (roughly Rs. 9,500), and availability is via Honor’s website.
title: Honor Earbuds 4 Launched Globally With Active Noise Cancellation, Up to 46 Hours of Total Battery Life

description: A determined young man’s entrepreneurial dreams clash with his father’s expectations, leading to a gripping journey of love, ambition and conflict.
title: Alpha: Men Love Vengeance OTT Release, Cast, Plot & Where to Watch on Amazon Prime Video

description: Nicolas Cage's upcoming series, Spider-Noir, now has a release date. The series will land on Amazon Prime Video, where it will centre around a retired superhero confronting the bad bosses.
title: Spider-Noir OTT Release Date: When and Where to Watch Nicolas Cage Starrer

description: Pearl Abyss is rolling out Patch 1.04.00 for Crimson Desert across all platforms. The patch brings three new difficulty options, improvements to inventory, distant scenery visuals, UI, combat, and more. Crimson Desert has received regular patches since it launched on March 19.
title: Crimson Desert Gets Difficulty Settings, Graphical Upgrades and Inventory Improvements in Latest Patch

description: Sui-based DeFi protocol Volo reported a $3.5 million breach affecting select vaults. The team has frozen a portion of the stolen funds and said unaffected vaults remain secure. The protocol also plans to absorb losses as concerns around DeFi security continue to grow.
title: Volo Freezes Funds, Limits Damage After $3.5 Million Sui Blockchain Exploit

description: Lava Bold N1 5G launched in a 6GB RAM + 128GB storage configuration. It features a 6.75-inch HD+ display and has an IP54 rating for dust and water resistance. It has a 13-megapixel dual rear camera unit and a 5,000mAh battery with 10W fast charging support. It has a Unisoc T765 processor under the hood. It has a face unlock feature and includes a side-mounted fingerprint scanner.
title: Lava Bold N1 5G Arrives in New 6GB RAM, 256GB Storage Variant in India: Price, Features

description: Apple started rolling out the iOS 26.4.2 update on Wednesday. While the latest update does not include any new features, it does fix a major bug. The new firmware version comes with the security patch CVE-2026-28950. The patch addresses an issue related to Notification Services on devices running iOS 26.4.1 or earlier iOS versions, where the devices stored deleted message notifications in their notification database. This bug was reportedly exploited by the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) of the US managed to access deleted Signal messages from the iPhone’s notification database.
title: iOS 26.4.2 Update Rolled Out With Fix for Bug Used to Extract Notifications for Deleted Chats

description: Written and directed by Santosh Bellanna, Jagannath is a Telugu action drama film that is now available to rent on Prime Video. The film explores themes of revenge, love, and betrayal, and stars Rayalaseelam Bharath and Saara Aachar in the lead roles.
title: Jagannath Now Available For Rent on Prime Video: All You Need to Know About Plot, Cast, and More

description: iPhone 18 has been in the rumour mill recently, with leaks suggesting it might not come with major upgrades over the iPhone 17. According to a new supply chain report, the divide between the standard and Pro models could get even wider this year compared to previous generations, especially in terms of display features. The iPhone 18 will reportedly use an older OLED panel manufactured by Samsung’s display division, while the Pro models could adopt the latest in display technology.
title: iPhone 18 Could Fall Behind iPhone 17 With Older Display Material, Widening Gap With Pro Models: Report

description: A fun-filled Malayalam village comedy, Ambalamukkile Visheshangal follows an unemployed man’s chaotic life as he navigates love, gossip, and societal pressure.
title: Ambalamukkile Visheshangal Now Streaming Online: What You Need to Know About this Malayalam Comedy Movie Online?

description: Moto G87 showed up on Motorola’s official support page ahead of any official announcement. The listing shows an overview of the basic hardware. It has also been spotted in a European retailer, which usually suggests that its launch is just weeks away. It could run on a MediaTek chipset. It is likely to be released in six Pantone-approved colours. It could pack 8GB RAM and 256GB storage.
title: Moto G87 Price and Colour Options Revealed via Product Listing, Support Page

description: Google is testing a Verified Email system on Android that could remove the need for OTPs and email links during app sign-ups. According to Android Developers, the feature uses Credential Manager to confirm a user’s email instantly through a secure on-device credential. A native prompt lets users approve access in one tap. The system can also support account recovery and sensitive actions, though developers are advised to keep fallback verification methods.
title: Google Showcases Verified Email Feature Designed to Speed Up Android App Signups

description: Google has introduced new AI-powered features for Google Workspace at Google Cloud Next 2026. The update includes Workspace Intelligence, expanded “Take Notes for me” in Google Meet, and enhanced Google Sheets with interactive canvas tools. Google also added automation “skills,” improved Google Vids avatars, and deeper Gemini integration. New developer tools, security controls, and migration features from Microsoft 365 are also part of the rollout.
title: Google Unveils New Gemini-Powered Features, Workspace Intelligence and More at Google Cloud Next 2026

description: Bitcoin hovered near $78,000 on Thursday as institutional demand and ETF inflows supported prices. Analysts say the market remains in consolidation, with resistance near $80,000 and macro cues likely to drive the next move.
title: Bitcoin Price Nears $78,000, Consolidation Remains Below Key Resistance Level

description: The Online Gaming Authority of India is constituted as an attached office of MeitY. This multi-sectoral body will be chaired by the Additional Secretary, MeitY (ex officio), with joint secretary-level representatives from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Finance (Department of Financial Services), Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Youth Affairs and Sports, and Law and Justice (Department of Legal Affairs).
title: Online Gaming Rules Notified, Will Go Into Effect From May 1

description: Poco C81 series has been launched in India. The lineup includes two models, dubbed Poco C81 and Poco C81x. The smartphones will go on sale in the country on April 27 via Flipkart. The standard model is offered in three colour options, called Elite Black, Ice Blue, and Sunset Gold. On the other hand, the Poco C81x misses out on the Sunset Gold colourway. Both handsets are powered by the same octa core Unisoc T7250 chipset, paired with an ARM Mali-G57 GPU. The Poco C81 ships with Xiaomi’s HyperOS 3, which is built on top of Android 16.
title: Poco C81 Launched in India With 6,300mAh Battery, 13-Megapixel Camera Alongside Poco C81x: Price, Specifications

description: Microsoft Gaming CEO Asha Sharma announced a new Discord partnership for Xbox Game Pass and said the company would continue to make the game subscription service "more flexible" for players. Sharma said the details of the new partnership would be shared soon. Earlier this week, Microsoft slashed the price of Xbox Game Pass Ultimate, with Sharma saying it had become "too expensive".
title: Xbox Chief Asha Sharma Teases Discord Partnership, Promises to Make Game Pass 'More Flexible'

description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) is said to be holding talks with global regulators, domestic lenders, and government officials to assess potential risks linked to Anthropic’s new artificial intelligence (AI) model, Mythos. According to a report, RBI’s preliminary assessment points towards Mythos potentially raising cybersecurity concerns by expediting the discovery and exploitation of software vulnerabilities.
title: RBI Said to Evaluate Cybersecurity Risks Linked to Anthropic’s Mythos Amid Concerns of Unauthorised Access

description: OnePlus is all set to expand its mid-range smartphone lineup in India with the launch of the OnePlus Nord CE 6 and Nord CE 6 Lite. Ahead of their anticipated debut, the company has revealed the key features of the Nord CE 6. The handset will be equipped with a 144Hz display, supporting up to 144fps gaming in select titles. It is teased to feature a 50-megapixel primary camera with optical image stabilisation (OIS). The OnePlus Nord CE 6 will come with quad IP ratings along with MIL-STD-810H certification for durability.
title: OnePlus Nord CE 6 Key Features Revealed Ahead of India Launch; to Get 144Hz Display, 50-Megapixel Camera

description: Apple is said to be working on several upgrades for future iPhone models, including a 1/1.12-inch ultra-large main sensor, optical image stabilisation (OIS) for ultra-wide lenses, and a 200-megapixel periscope telephoto camera. The iPhone 18 Pro models are said to offer a variable aperture system. If the testing proves successful, these technologies will be rolled out progressively with each new generation, with a slightly curved aperture emerging as a defining feature.
title: Apple Tipped to Introduce Camera Upgrades Through 2028;  iPhone 18 Pro Could Lead Shift to Advanced Imaging

description: Lenovo Legion Y900 (2026) will be launched in 11.1-inch and 13-inch display sizes, the tech firm announced on Thursday. The upcoming gaming tablet will feature a 12-bit display, delivering up to 144Hz of refresh rate, 4K (3,840 x 2,560 pixels) resolution, 3:2 aspect ratio, up to 1,100 nits peak brightness, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, PWM dimming, up to 2,340Hz touch sampling rate, Dolby Vision, and Corning Gorilla 7i protection, along with TÜV Rheinland True 4K High Visual Clarity, Low Blue Light, and Flicker-Free certifications.
title: Lenovo Legion Y900 (2026) Display Sizes, Other Specifications Confirmed Weeks Ahead of Launch

description: Asus Pad could launch soon. Ahead of the formal launch, renders and specifications of the Android tablet have leaked online. The renders show the device with a single rear camera and curved display. The Asus Pad is tipped to come with a 12.2-inch dual-layer OLED display with a 144Hz refresh rate. It is said to house a 9,000mAh battery with fast charging speed.
title: Asus Pad Spotted in Leaked Design Renders; Tipped to Feature 9,000mAh Battery, 12.2-Inch Screen

description: LinkedIn, the Microsoft-owned professional networking platform, has named Daniel Shapero as the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Shapero will be taking over from the outgoing CEO Ryan Roslansky, who held the position for five years and 11 months. Until April 2026, Shapero served as the Chief Operating Officer at LinkedIn, and has been associated with the company for more than 18 years. On top of this, the company has announced that its Indian-origin Senior Vice President of Engineering, Mohak Shroff, will also be assuming charge as the President, Platforms & Digital Work at Microsoft.
title: Microsoft Picks Daniel Shapero as New LinkedIn CEO as Part of Major Management Shuffle

description: Google is reportedly testing a redesigned Gemini interface on Android with brighter colours and a cleaner layout. According to a new report, the update includes gradient backgrounds, refined dark mode, minimal icons, and a revamped sidebar that may expand fully. Changes could extend to temporary chats and Gemini Live, which may also gain a new animated control. The features were found in an APK teardown and may change before release.
title: Google's Gemini App Might Be Updated With Brighter UI, Redesigned Layout on Android: Report

description: Vivo has officially confirmed the launch date of its upcoming Vivo Y600 Pro in China for next week. It is expected to arrive as the successor to the Vivo Y500 Pro, which was introduced in November 2025. Ahead of its anticipated debut, the company has also revealed key details around its battery, durability, and display. The Y600 Pro is confirmed to have the largest battery capacity of any Vivo smartphone to date. It will run on OriginOS 6 based on Android 16.
title: Vivo Y600 Pro China Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Feature 1.5K Display, 10,200mAh Battery

description: Curiosity rover found its target crater filled with sand, forcing NASA to abandon drilling plans. The rover is now studying nearby bedrock and preparing to sample a new sulfate-rich site to uncover Mars’ geological history.
title: NASA’s Curiosity Rover Finds Crater Filled With Sand, Alters Drilling Plans

description: The future of OnePlus has been the subject of the rumour mill for some time now. Some rumours indicate that the company could move to an online-only sales model, while others point towards it completely shutting up shop in certain markets. Amidst speculation, OnePlus has announced its upcoming smartwatch — the OnePlus Watch 4. It is perceived as a strange move, however, as it was not subject to much fanfare but was silently listed on the company’s China and global websites, with all of the major specifications revealed.
title: OnePlus 16 Could Feature Up to 240Hz Display and Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro SoC, Tipster Claims
